results.remarks:
This beautifully preserved 1910 Craftsman bungalow brings together the character of its original design with thoughtful improvements completed over the years. Recognized by the Historical Society and carrying its historic designation, the home has been carefully maintained with attention to its comfort, functionality, and architectural integrity.

Improvements throughout the property include updates to major systems, the kitchen, electrical and plumbing, HVAC, and the front porch. The work has been completed with consideration for the home’s existing style, allowing its original character to remain at the heart of the property.

Formerly known as the Otts Ranch House, the home was once the centerpiece of a 10-acre orange grove established in 1910, connecting the property to Hemet’s agricultural history. Its classic double-gable roofline, original woodwork, period millwork, vintage details, and original fireplace continue to reflect the craftsmanship of its era.

Beyond the white picket fence, the covered front porch offers a welcoming place to enjoy the established surroundings. Inside, the parlor leads into the formal dining room, where the original fireplace remains a focal point. The remodeled kitchen provides improved functionality while remaining complementary to the home’s preserved style.

The home includes two spacious bedrooms, one full bathroom, a powder room, and an additional flex space that provides versatility for a variety of uses.

Outside, the property includes a detached garage for covered parking and storage, along with mature fruit trees that contribute to the established landscape and provide seasonal harvests.

With thoughtful improvements made throughout and many of its distinctive architectural details preserved, this Craftsman continues to reflect more than a century of Hemet history while offering the warmth and comfort of a home that has been cared for through the years.

results.remarks: Nestled just below the iconic Ramona Bowl in Hemet’s highly desirable Southeast area, this enchanting French Country farmhouse is the kind of property that feels almost impossible to find at this price point. Charming, distinctive & brimming with potential, this may be one of the cutest & most captivating farmhouse-on-acreage properties you could possibly buy in this price range. With panoramic views that seem to stretch for days, a beautiful sense of privacy + an abundance of usable land, this is far more than a home—it’s a rare opportunity to create the property you’ve always dreamed of. From the moment you arrive, the curb appeal is undeniable. A welcoming front porch sets the tone for this beautifully updated country retreat, while the thoughtfully designed grounds and mature landscaping add to the property’s unmistakable character. Inside, timeless farmhouse charm meets elevated California-country style. Original hardwood floors bring warmth & authenticity, while a new ROOF and AC, upgraded windows & beautifully refreshed bathrooms add modern comfort. The gorgeous granite kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring a classic farmhouse sink, generous workspace + an overhead pot rack that feels right at home in this sophisticated country setting. Think Amber Lewis meets French Country farmhouse: warm, collected, effortless + beautifully lived-in. The open & airy floor plan invites you effortlessly from the living room into the dining area, where classic French doors open to what may quickly become your favorite space—the expansive back deck. Here, the views are simply spectacular. Imagine morning coffee overlooking the hills, evenings watching the sky transform at sunset, or a glass of wine beneath the stars. The sunsets alone are worth falling in love with. And then there’s the acreage—where this property truly shines. The grounds offer an incredible amount of flexibility & potential for whatever your vision may be: gardens, animals, outdoor entertaining, recreational toys, RVs, workshops, hobbies, or simply room to breathe & enjoy the freedom that comes w/ having space of your own. The property is practically its own little fruit grove, w/ an impressive selection of established fruit trees including nectarine, pomegranate, grapefruit, plum & lemon—a true bonus for anyone who dreams of growing, gardening and enjoying the fruits of their own land. Truly a beautiful place to escape the ordinary, this little farmhouse is ready for its next chapter.

results.remarks: Unobstructed 360* VIEWS from this four acre, mostly flat and gently sloping land.  Enter through the gates of the property and appreciate the soft breeze, the distance from the neighbors, and the serenity.  A perfect place for a staycation.  Plenty of room for horses, sheds, more corrals, tack room, barn..... whatever works best for you.  Upon approach to the home, you are welcomed by a porch where you can enjoy morning sunrises, evening sun sets and to be one with your surroundings.  The serenity of nature.  Once you enter the home you can see the natural light throughout with the high ceilings, multiple windows and corner fireplace with rock surround.  The kitchen has three points of access and is the heart of the home.  Another family room is at the opposite end of the home so everyone has a place when hosting friends and family.  The primary suite is by the entry and offers dual vanities, separate shower ower and soaking tub, plus the water closet with door and window.  The closet in the room is huge and there is a sitting area in the room at the front of the home.  The formal dining room is at the back of the home next to the kitchen, great room and laundry room.  The first secondary bedroom is on the other side of the home in the back and is separated from the two other secondary bedrooms by the 2nd living area.  There is a room off of the entry that can serve as whatever fits you - office, den, workout room...  Out back there are two water storage tanks and a corral.  This is a corner property.

Step into this inviting lovely home where comfort meets craftsmanship. Throughout the home is ceramic tile, upgraded carpet in the bedrooms and ceiling fans in every room to keep you cool and comfortable. The large master bedroom features a walk in cedar lined closet that adds a touch of luxury and freshness. Master bath features upgraded shower and fixtures. Second bath is also upgraded with a new tiled shower/bath combo and new fixtures.
Just off the kitchen, the warm and welcoming family room offers a rock-faced gas/wood burning fireplace, creating a cozy gathering spot for evenings in. This unique home includes custom oak woodwork throughout, crown moulding and wainscoting, a fully finished 2 car garage with built in storage and cabinets plus additional storage for seasonal items. Outside a gate ironed driveway extension provides secure parking for extra vehicles or small trailer/ATV. The generously sized fully fenced backyard and ample side yard has plenty of room for a pool and features cactus and citrus trees. Additionally, there is an 8x12 storage shed for tools and gardening equipment and a fenced in kennel area ideal for pets. Recent upgrades include newer composition roof, upgraded bathrooms with modern faucets which give the home a clean, move-in ready feel. This home also features an oversized HVAC for maximum comfort. This property blends charm, practicality, and room to grow~ a wonderful place to call home!

results.remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully renovated golf course home in the desirable Seven Hills 55+ community in Hemet. This 1,834 sq ft home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a dedicated office, with a 2-car garage plus a golf cart garage for added convenience.

Inside you’ll find high ceilings, skylights in the kitchen, brand new luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring, fresh paint, and updated fixtures and ceiling fans throughout, creating a bright and modern feel.

Step outside to a spacious backyard directly on the golf course, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The outdoor space features an expansive covered patio, outdoor kitchen with barbecue, gas fire pit, and a charming 2-seater swing, with patio space extending through both the backyard and side yard to enjoy the beautiful surroundings.
The home also includes a Tesla EV charger in the garage, offering convenient at-home charging for electric vehicles.

Located in the active 55+ Seven Hills community, residents enjoy access to a golf course, clubhouse, fitness center, pool, and social activities, all while benefiting from an incredibly low HOA of only $45 per year and being close to shopping, dining, and local amenities.

Just minutes from the city, this home is also close to Diamond Valley Lake—one of Southern California’s largest man-made reservoirs—offering a wide range of recreational activities including fishing, boating, biking, hiking, and seasonal wildflower viewing.
The home is also just minutes from the beautiful Soboba Casino Resort, offering entertainment, dining, and live events, and is conveniently located within driving distance of Temecula and Murrieta, known for their wineries, shopping, restaurants, and entertainment.
This move-in ready golf course home offers comfort, upgrades, and resort-style living in one of Hemet’s most sought-after communities.
